Press Down+A to fall through the wooden platforms.
Rise, prisoner. The time for your escape has come...

Questions will be answered later. For now, you must trust me if you
wish to live.

Try to find a way to fix the broken lever behind me. It is your only
exit from here.
I will wait for you on the other side.
I've been waiting for you...
Good luck...
mrghm... hungryyyy...

Leave me alone, kid!
I don't want any trouble...
It's safer inside here...

A decrepit wooden bed with an old, filthy mattress riddled with
stains.
A worn book full of notes from the Chief Jailer...
One of the last entries says:

"The meal portions for prisoner 64 must be increased."
"Again..."

A faded worn book, within its fragile pages,
a haunting sentence reads:

"Cornered by shadows, trapped within stone walls, hope dwindles
silently...
There is no escape...
The [color:#09e522FF] Necrolord [/color] watches every little step..."
A rusted iron door.
It's locked...
Erhmm... You're not supposed to be here...
This zone is not available in the demo version.

A mysterious glowing object...
It emits a humming noise...
What is that?
It is too dark to see anything...
I can't go any further like this.
This zone is not available in the Demo version.
There's a weird object on the shelf.
This grandfather clock serves as a [color:#bddc32] Checkpoint [/color], saving your progress [br] and allowing you to resume from here if you fail.
The lever is missing from its base.

A large glass flask connected to a smaller vessel, filled with a greenish
liquid...
A traveler!
How delightful!
Allow me to introduce myself...
I am the [color:#09e522FF] Rift Engine[/color], your gateway to distant places [br] --well, once you unlock another of my kind...
You see, I can only connect to active engines.[br]No destination, no teleportation!
So... your task? [br]Find and wake my sleeping siblings. [br]Once linked, you'll blink between us with ease!
A crumbling stone shrine, adorned with an owl statue...
An inscription is carved into the base.
"A sightless owl with a [color:#09e522FF] sword [/color] in her keep offers steel to the one who [br] ends her [color:#09e522FF]eyeless [/color] sleep."
An old desk covered in dust...
The middle drawer looks well used.
A small iron chest with a hexagonal slot in the lid...
It's locked. A seal with a sun symbol seems to be missing.
A sturdy wooden locker reinforced with metal hinges.
It's securely locked...
A fire burns in the fireplace, sending a warm orange glow.
It feels so much better than the chill of that cold cell.

The locker is open now.
There's some kind of lever inside!
A metal key hangs on the wall.
A stone gate blocked by wooden planks...
I can't remove them with my bare hands...
I need my wetsuit to go deeper.
